_: THE SWEEP THAT SAYS AN ATTRIBUTE DECLARATION NO DOCUMENT COULD MATCH IS
REFUSED — run it from the repository root:
WHAT THE CONTRACT IS. `InventoryAttribute::new` is the one door into an
inventory attribute declaration — a TOML declaration deserializes through it —
so a declaration a caller builds and one a workspace declares are refused on
the same terms. Each refusal names a declaration that could never match a
document: a namespace that is empty or holds whitespace, a name that carries a
prefix or is not an XML local name, and an extension list that is empty or
holds something no file extension is. The reader's own guards are swept next
TEN INJECTIONS, ONE PER REFUSAL, plus the marker declaration's own
`deny_unknown_fields` and the case-insensitive extension match. Each must
redden the config test that asks it — through the constructor AND through a
TOML declaration, which is the pair that keeps the two paths one.
RUN IT LOCALLY. The harness edits this tree and writes the firing record

injections.name: an-empty-namespace-is-accepted
injections.why: an empty URI names no namespace, so the declaration matches nothing and says nothing

injections.name: whitespace-in-a-namespace-is-accepted
injections.why: no namespace URI holds whitespace, so such a declaration matches no attribute in any document

injections.name: a-prefixed-name-is-accepted
injections.why: the Round 1322 and 1323 mistake in declaration form: a prefix is the document's own binding, so `sce:req` as a name matches nothing and reads as though the prefix were the identity

injections.name: a-name-no-document-could-carry-is-accepted
injections.why: a name outside the XML local-name grammar is one no document can carry, so the axis reads nothing and reports it as clean

injections.name: an-empty-extension-list-is-accepted
injections.why: an attribute declared for no extension reads no document — a declared axis that is structurally disabled

injections.name: an-empty-extension-is-accepted
injections.why: an empty extension matches no file, so it is a line in the config that does nothing

injections.name: a-dotted-extension-is-accepted
injections.why: `.scxml` is the obvious way to write an extension and matches nothing, since an extension is the text after the last dot

injections.name: a-whitespace-extension-is-accepted
injections.why: an extension holding whitespace matches no file either

injections.name: an-extension-is-matched-case-sensitively
injections.why: a document named `MODEL.SCXML` is the same kind of document as `model.scxml`, and a case-sensitive match reads one and not the other

injections.name: a-key-a-declaration-does-not-model-is-dropped
injections.why: a key such as a separator the declaration does not model would be accepted and silently ignored
